changelog: - **Refreshing a table after a column was removed no longer blocks other tables.** When Data ▸ Refresh removed a column from a table while a row missing from the new data was left undecided (neither unlinked nor deleted), that row kept its value for the removed column. Until the document was reopened, refreshing any other table of the document was then refused with This data could not be stored safely, however good its data. The undecided row now keeps only the values of the columns the table still has, so the other tables refresh as before. A document saved in that state needs nothing: the value was already dropped when it was opened.
